sideB.text:
ANTANANARIVO
18°52'45"S 47°30'29"E

Island map art with a bullseye sticker circle on Madagascar. Anchor on the compass. No search box.

The bottom edge repeats ANTANANARIVO and the coordinates upside down.

rules: Second black Player card for Antananarivo. Port. No search.
The bullseye in the map art is the player-card upgrade slot.
notes: Same coordinates as the search card: 18°52'45"S 47°30'29"E.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
